Brewis Towing Heads & Swivels

New Zealand-made towing heads and swivels — supported by Blick.

Brewis Engineering manufactures premium towing heads and HDD swivels in New Zealand. From simple standard towing heads to sealed mudtight systems and PE fuse-on solutions, Brewis covers the full range of pipe pullback requirements for HDD, thrust boring, and pipe bursting operations.

When you buy Brewis through Blick, you get locally made precision equipment with expert sizing advice, fast delivery, and the backing of Blick's HDD field expertise.

Product Range

Brewis towing heads & swivels

From standard external grip to mudtight sealed and fuse-on systems — Brewis has a towing head for every pipe pullback scenario.

Standard Towing Heads

Simple external grip towing heads for PE pipe pullbacks. Available from 20mm to 900mm OD. Installed in seconds — no welding, no fusing, no special tools required.

Request sizing

Mudtight Gold Sealed

Premium sealed towing heads for mudtight pullbacks. Designed for SDR 11 and SDR 17.6 PE pipe, 32mm to 355mm. Prevents drilling fluid entering the pipe during installation.

Request sizing

PE Fuse-On Towing Heads

Butt-fused to PE pipe for maximum pull strength. Available for SDR 9, 11, and 17.6 pipe from 50mm to 710mm. The strongest connection method for high-force pullbacks.

Request sizing

Carrot Towing Heads

Internal grip towing heads that expand inside the pipe. Ideal for 18mm to 24mm ID pipes where external grip isn't practical. Quick to install and remove.

Request sizing

MiniRig HDD Swivels

Patented sealing system for 10 to 30 US Ton capacity. ALCOEP greased bearings for long service life. Essential for any HDD pullback — prevents pipe rotation and transmits pull force cleanly.

Request specs
Selection Guide

Not sure which towing head you need?

The right towing head depends on your pipe material (PE, PVC, steel), outside diameter, SDR rating, and the pull force involved. Brewis publishes a selection guide, but the fastest way to get the right answer is to talk to Blick — we'll size it for you.

We carry the most common Brewis sizes in stock. Specialist sizes and custom orders available on short lead times.
